title: StreamPart
description: Owned runtime streaming envelope with event/data parity and explicit subgraph namespacing from corpus Section 6.1.

event.description: Namespaced event name; message events use the messages prefix by convention.

data.description: Open event payload for this stream part.

subgraph_path.description: Required subgraph namespace path; empty means the root graph, and non-empty paths preserve nested custom events from corpus Section 6.1.

ordinal.description: Per-producer stream ordering token matching the Event ordinal contract.

ts.description: RFC3339 timestamp for when the stream part was emitted.
